rationale.text: ARI offense has a 100% pass rate, 45% success rate, and -0.06 EPA/play on 3rd & long, which is well above league average in pass rate and success rate but below league average in EPA, indicating a high pass volume with limited efficiency gains.
LA defense allows 30% success rate and 31% pass success rate on 3rd & long, with a 32% blitz rate, indicating a high pressure and man coverage tendency that makes deep passes and long runs risky.
In opponent territory, ARI has a 56% pass rate, 56% success rate, and +0.12 EPA/play, which is above league average and shows strong performance in zone coverage environments.
LA defense allows 41% success rate and -0.14 EPA/play in opponent territory, which is below league average in success rate and shows a defensive tendency to limit offensive progress in zone coverage.

In trailing by one score in fourth quarter, ARI has a 75% pass rate and 41% success rate, which is above league average in pass rate and slightly below in success rate, indicating a strong tendency to pass under pressure.
